review_description: Great professional service with high quality components. Came out to inspect the house prior to installation and happy to answer any questions before and during installation.

Blue Mountains Solar provided a very informative seminar detailing everything you needed to know to make an informed choice. They carried out an on-site visit and discussed options. They gave a very detailed and informative quote in a booklet. Their pricing was comparable to other companies that were consulted. They were not the cheapest, nor the most expensive. The quotes provided through Solar Quotes were helpful.The installation was carried out promptly, tidily, and professionally. The after sales service has been excellent. Blue Mountains Solar has been trading locally for over 12 years and have a great reputation. The quality of their work and after sales service is their best advertising.I recommend them very highly and I also recommend Solar Quotes very highly.
Visited site, listened to my questions and answered in a friendly fashion.System was installed efficiently and on timed neatly.The small problem I had with system reporting was attended to promptly.

I was very impressed with the level of service from first point of contact through to answering questions during  waiting for the install.On the day of Install, Damien and his crew were punctual , friendly and remained professional during the install .I was also impressed with the high quality of their work.Damien also assisted me with setting up the phone  app and explained how to use the app as well as well .I showed Damien my recent power bill and and asked him a few questions  about approximate projected savings  estimates  for future bills , which he explained in great detail.Damien was very patient in answering my questions.I would highly recommend the team from Blue Mountains Solar for your install.JeffWindradyne
Damian and his team did an excellent job.I am well satisfied.Now I just have to wait for Origin Energy to change the meter so I can be credited for the power I'm exporting to the grid!

Another company  and Blue Mountains Solar presented clear and precise information about their quotes. They took time to answer all my questions. I chose Blue Mountains Solar because they offered the Sunpower panels. The installation began on time. The installers were extremely polite and tidy. After the install they organised the grid connection. They explained how the the monitoring system works and ensured it was operational before they left. Very impressed.

Great service, didnâ€™t try to upsell in fact  talked me out of a battery ( 5 years ago). Had done homework prior to visit and could discuss my personal needs looking at electricity bill and asking questions about lifestyle
We are getting the solar on the 13/12/2017.

Blue Mountains Solar, 4 kW solar install in September 2017 in Katoomba NSW. Damian and his 2 co-workers/installers arrived on time, early morning, and completed the whole solar installation before noon, with minimal noise, no disruption to us (apart from turning power off and on a few times), and placement of panels on 2 different areas of our roof. Damian made sure everything was working AOK. He returned a number of times, without us asking, as he monitors our system via his workplace, to tweak the system. The inverter was turning on and off in the mornings and a fault in the earth/ground somewhere was showing up, Damian traced the fault to a rusty earth/ground rod connection we had installed about 10 years earlier, he cleaned and repaired it, and have had no problems since. Excellent service, excellent install, we highly recommend Blue Mountains Solar.
Good, no nonsense advice.

So glad I've done it! I'm battery ready and will upgrade in 2 years as the technology becomes cheaper. I'm only sorry I didn't ask for the smart meter - I really want to know more about my generation and usage - will wait for the batteries and then get one.The install was so quick and the post-install customer support is good. Blue Mountains Solar are very good on their word!It was a lot of money (just under $9,500) but I am happy with the quality of the components and the service by Damian and his team.I also got good thick curtains throughout the house and  topped-up my ceiling space insulation to make the best of the heating/cooling. Insulation is just as important!Thanks so much for your service - I went to your site often to make sense of everything!

Our dealings with Blue Mountains Solar have met or exceeded all of our expectations, including installing higher capacity solar panels at no additional charge. We chose BM Solar for a few reasons: a well established, well reputed local business, offering the worldâ€™s best available products in SunPower panels and SMA inverter.  Salesman Lewis arrived with a comprehensive written proposal, which included an item by item costed quotation (which none of our other 3 quoters provided), which helped us to negotiate and sign a contract on the spot.Owner Damian and Tom arrived on the promised installation date, and were finished by 2pm, leaving behind only the installed Solar System, which is of the highest installation standard + very happy Customers.  Very pleasant and easy to work with people.How could we not say that Blue Mountains Solar are fantastic!

The system has been up for two weeks. No issues. The installation team were excellent and efficient with the installation. The only negative, and it is by choice. is the cost of the Sunpower panels. They are very good, however I wonder if they are worth twice the cost of standard panels.

This is the second house at which I've installed a solar system. My first experience with another solar installer in Sydney was mediocre, but my second experience with Blue Mountains Solar was excellent. I installed 5.88kW of panels (18 x 327W Sunpower panels) and a Sunnyboy 5kW inverter. I've had the system installed for about 5 months now and the output is excellent. Damien and the team were attentive and offered a competitive price for this installation. Because the installation occurred as part of a larger home renovation I was impressed with the coordination and communication with me, the electrician, and the building team. Because of Damian's more advanced electrical certification he went above and beyond the call of duty to assist my electrician with some incidental but related work. In summary, my experience was great and I'd happily recommend Blue Mountains Solar. When I decide to install a battery system, they'll be the first ones I call.
Installers gave two days notice of installation date and time - excellent.

Of the 3 companies referred to me only Blue Mountains Solar visited my premises.One of the companies just sent a quote then badgered me to sign up, the other would not answer the questions I had about installation and during discussions with their representative they refused to discuss, in detail, the concerns that I had.I am very, very pleased with Blue Mountains Solar

Blue Mountains Solar were very open about all the details including the cost, and although the most expensive of the three quotes, theirs was the best value for money based on the guaranteed level of performance of the system over 25 years.  Damien and his team arrived to do the installation when they said they would and were efficient, respectful and provided all the information I needed and the system was up and running immediately. My neighbour has the same system installed by Blue Mountains Solar four years ago and gave me great feedback on the performance of the system and Blue Mountains Solar which added to my confidence in my decision. Thank you Solar Quotes for providing all the background information to enable me to make an informed decision.

Happy with the guys recommend by you all provided good service,but in the end decided to support a local business and the feedback on your site re blue mts solar was invaluable. Thanks heaps for your follow up and advice.

I received 2 responses from the 3 suggested. Whilst the Solaray guide price was lower then BM Solar, I was happy to proceed with them based on the equipment provided and the fact they are a local business. Installation was delayed by about a month from quote acceptance which I accept was mainly due to wet weather in this period.
They communicated well.  They came when they said they would.  They were efficient in the installation and the panels they use are copper backed instead of plastic.

Blue Mountains Solar was absolutely fantastic to us from the initial interview to the completion of the installation. The explanations, the many questions answered, the time spent with us in person and via e-mails, and the apparent and obvious knowledge, eliminated the other quotes immediately. Explained at length the mechanism and answered our multitude of questions with great understanding. These characteristics were particularly so when we were learning about the inverters and also the function of the NET meter. We are now recording readings from the inverters and the NET meter (and learning more as we travel this course) in preparation for Blue Mountains Solar's return visit to check on the efficiency of the installation. We cannot praise them enough. Carolyn & Ian. Bathurst, New South Wales.
Damian McMahon and his team from Blue Mountains Solar were exceptional - professional, informative, enthusiastic and courteous. Highly recommended.

This installation included LG batteries and SMA Inverter, SMA Sunny Island for on and off grid applications and Sunny Home Manager. The panels are Sunpower X-Series with 345w power. I intend using Reposit software when it is developed and available for the SMA equipment. The SMA have the reputation for being the state of the art equipment and the panels are the most efficient, and are locally supported, with the best guarantee as well as the LG battery I am using. I understand at 15 years guarantee the batteries are way in front of the competition. As well as this they are very compact and can easily be added to if needs be, to achieve practical independence from grid supplied power.  I am assured this system makes better use of the sun power generated. The SMA system includes access to their web site to see exactly how the system is performing.There is no doubt this is not the cheapest available but I feel confident the system and supplier are the best available and well worth the cost.I am adding this system to my original 1.5kW system earning .60c per kW.

First of all, I am a person who likes to purchase the best quality I can afford.I have been thinking of installing a Solar System on my home in Medlow Bath for some time now, and as usual, things that happen in life kept pushing the decision back, also I do not buy into the throw away society which is far too prevelant today.What I was looking for was a company that was going to install a system that was going to last, would have good manufacturer backed warranties,and was local.After conducting a quick google search it seemed there was only one company that was in my area which was Blue Mountains Solar.There were no pushy sales techniques, the staff explained clearly to me why the product was superior to other product and pointed out that although I may pay a bit extra for my Sunpower system it was going to last.Now I have a system on my roof that is producing more energy than I expected, has a 25 year manufacturers warranty (not to mention the manufacturers 25 year performance guarantee, seems the industry average is 10 years) and its also battery ready.What company nowadays says to a customer that batteries are great but to advise me that I should wait a couple of years for the capacity to increase and the prices to fall?Ok, so I am a very happy customer.Thank you Blue Mountains Solar and the whole team.... Awesome

Blue Mountain Solar arrived right at the time and day arranged. Damian and the team started work and were finished in a few hours. I said to my husband they were like the McLaren racing team in the pits. Everyone knew their job and just got into it. Site left clean and tidy and we were generating power as they left.Damian was honest and knowledgeable as another review said his enthusiasm is infectious. He is a straight talker and not pushy. Gives you the facts and allows you to make the decision without the high pressure sales pitch. An absolutely wonderful company to deal with. Would and have recommended them to others looking for solar energy, We are about to upgrade our panels with Blue Mountains Solar prior to the 60 cent rebate expiring and look forward to using them again.

The service was excellent from giving an on site quote right through to installation . Our panels have only just been installed but we are really pleased with the whole process which was completely stress free & professional .

I liked the straight forward no nonsense approach from this local business.  They were honest and gave excellent advice.They were prompt, arrived when they said they would and connected us on the same day, no waiting for a Level 2 electrician.Followed up to check everything was OK without being asked.We are very happy with our system.

I had quotes from Nicholls and Mark group. I preferred to go with the local installer because he's local and he was prepared to talk to me about all the technicalities. I'm an electrical engineer and therefore I expect to be treated like one and not another punter. He is the supplier and installer. I can understand all the fine points regarding the construction and operation of panels and inverters. I did not feel that I was dealing with anybody but a pure salesman with all other suppliers who have called me. I especially did not appreciate the hard sell by Mark group. I am the hardest person to sell to if my knowledge is not respected. I do not buy on price. I buy on good engineering and the integrity of the person I deal with. I'm naturally sceptical of all salespeople and the solar panels industry seems to have attracted the usual bunch of carpet baggers.

It was such a pleasure dealing with Damien from Blue Miountains Solar. He was punctual, professional, gave great advice and the whole procerss from quote to instalation was smooth. I would happily recomend Blue Montains solar to friends.

Had Blue Mountains Solar install our solar system and couldn't ask for a better experience. The service provided was outstanding along with the quality of components to complete the solar install. With our roof being very challenging (45 degree angle), Blue Mountains Solar were able to sort it out and do an outstanding job. The knowledge and advice from Blue Mountains Solar made our decision easy on who to go with. Highly recommended!

Blue mountains solar have great advice on the type of setup I wanted with a clear analysis of what I needed to achieve a system that can be expanded in the future. Also, having an installer that is a current licenced electrician sped up the connection process by not having to rely on a third party to hook up to the grid.BMS were also very aware of keeping the aesthetics of my house in mind during placement of the panels on the roof.Finally, I was very comfortable with Damien's confident demeaner and a 'no hard sell' approach.

Highly recommended. No hard sell. Very knowledgeable about the products. Provide options and will discuss the pro and cons at length, to make sure you are comfortable with the solution. Came prepared for site survey with relevant information and was on-time. During installation, again Damian and Sebastian started work on time and by mid-day our system was fully operational. No mess, no waiting for connection. It just worked. Not the cheapest solution but I am impressed with the quality of work and solution. We are using LG Neo PV and SMA inverter with Tigo to maximise output in our shadowy location.

I used to be a university Professor (Finance).  I did the financial calculations in great detail and liked the rate-of-return for me.  I went for a slightly more expensive system thinking that the German SMA inverter and the highly efficient SunPower solar panels represented less operational risk for me, less break-down risk of the components, less risk of solar panel melt-down or inverter failure.  There are cheaper installations yet I see a trade-off between up-front cost and quality, leading to greater longevity of the overall installation with essentially zero maintenance issues.  Damian McMahon of Blue Mountains Solar did an excellent job.  His commitment to the benefits of solar PV technology is infectious.  From day one this system has simply worked and I've indeed had no need for any maintenance.  I plan to adopt a flexible battery system soon.  Damian is advising me on the choice of battery and configuration of the overall installation to maximise flexibility and the economic benefits.  SMA's web-based monitoring portal allows this client real-time monitoring of all that's going on with the PV system.

WE HAVE NO HESITATION IN RECOMMENDING BLUE MOUNTAINS SOLAR TO ANYONE LOOKING TO PURCHASE SOLAR PANELS. DAMIAN SHOWED FROM FIRST CONTACT THAT HE KNEW HIS PRODUCT WELL AND MY HUSBAND AND I FELT THAT WE COULD FEEL CONFIDENT GOING WITH HIM AS NOTHING SEEMED TO BE AN ISSUE AND THAT PROVED TO BE CORRECT AS HE WAS HERE ON TIME FOR A QUOTE AND AGAIN FOR THE INSTALLATION AND CLEANED UP WHEN THEY FINISHED WHICH WAS GREAT. GREAT JOB DAMIAN. HAPPY CUSTOMER

Blue Mountains Solar were the only company that offered to come to my house to evaluate the site and offer options.  Sure there were cheaper offers but none gave me the confidence BM Solar provided.Damian has always been punctual, knew his product, offered valuable advice/options and was always very professional.They came today spot on time, installed the system and had finished by around 1pm.  The place was left immaculately clean and tidy.  The system was explained to me and has already exceeded my expectations in it's output just today.A lot of mountains tradespeople could take a leaf out of BM Solar's book.  Well done Damian and Sebastian and I have no hesitation in recommending them to anyone.

HiPunctuality is one of my "things" you know part of that first impression, well Damian gave me a time for the quote but rang that morning looking for an earlier time then was bang on time.........First Star*Had done his home work and was well prepared, it was also obvious that he knew his stuff......Second Star**I had already received 2 other quotes so had a good idea what I wanted and what questions to ask, answers were straight forward in plain language and very easy to understand....Third Star***After receiving his quote and doing my own research on the quality of items to be supplied, I was impressed and please with the price, and most importantly with his suggestions for extra inclusions, which none of the others had even hinted about.....Fourth Star****A phone call 3 days later sealed the deal and a final "I will be there a week Friday in the morning" How many times have well all heard similar from trades people.....And how many times have we believed it? Well knock me down with a feather, Damian was here Friday morning and the job was expertly completed in the 4 hours quoted.....Fifth Star*****But it is the little things that mark the word excellent, like cardboard to protect the paint on the gutters, bringing my dog a bone so that we could all work in peace, installing my Watts Clever Meter, totally cleaning up the site when finished.Say what you will do, then do more....Ian L MackenzieMob. 0419704549

Blue Mountains Solar offer fantastic service, great advice and a quality install. We are very happy with our 4k system with SMA Inverter. Just waiting for our first bill to see the savings.We would highly recommend these guys to anyone looking for a quality solar system.
From start to finish felt confident in BM Solar's knowledge, experience, and common sense advice.

Informed, helpful service. Thorough site appraisal prior to advising of appropriate solar system for my needs. Arrived on time & left the site clean & tidy. Due to price rises from the panel manufacturer this installer isn't the cheapest quote, but hopefully the higher quality of the product will justify the extra cost. Good job.

Very impressed with their punctuality, efficiency and professionalism.  Damian gave sound, practical advice with no pressure salesmanship.  Nothing was too much trouble.  Only company in the area to provide Sunpower panels as an option.  Since they are the best panels in the world why go for anything less.They work as a team and to see men cleaning up after themselves was amazing.  WOW!We have no hesitation in saying that going with Blue Mountains Solar was the best choice we could have made.
The guys from Blue Mountains Solar were very professional.  Went about their business very well.  Everything was explained when job completed and we are very happy.
Best quality products on the market - 327w panels meant they fitted where I wanted them. High end inverter. Local team so support is good too.

The supplier of my Solar PV system was Blue Mountains Solar. installed on 20 August 2014. Found them in your list of Silver SuppliersThey are local business from our perspective because we live at the foot of the Blue Mountains.Mark Group could not accommodate me in their schedule - I will have to wait for another month.SolarRay is located at Mona Vale, around 65 Km from where we live - almost cross country from my perspective.While Blue Mountains Solar is closer to where we live.I sent you an email on 22 August. Resent that email on 19 Sept. 2014. Reported my good experience with Blue Mountains Solar.Blue Mountains Solar was great, very professional. I will recommend them to others.Their quote looked expensive at first glance but after further calculations their quote was very reasonable.

Got honest answers from the outset, as one previous reviewer said no BS.Came to site inspected and suggested system to buy and why. No high pressure sales pitch. Installation was as promised on time, and proffessional. Left the job clean. Damian is very patient  and prepared to spend whatever time is needed to answer your questions. Although not the cheapest I have no doubts I have bought a quality system and will have no problems. Higly recommended.Would like to write another review in 12 months after savings etc assessed

Though not the cheapest, one other company gave a quote site unseen which seems a bit slapdash. Another company never got back to me.The Blue Mountains guys came out, inspected the site, advised me on different panels but didn't push. They could have done the job with cheaper panels but I don't mind paying more for quality so I got market leading hardware.They were very professional & even got me some tiles to replace some they found cracked on my roof (at no extra charge). They even tidied up after themselves, shock & awe.We were generating power back to the grid on the same day, all done & dusted.A bit more expense, but: Top quality hardware, excellent service, a job well done & no BS.

Installers arrived on time, finished on time, cleaned up the mess afterwards .They were a very  professional team and very helpful explaining how to get the best out of the system and  the way the system operates. I have already recommended Blue  Mountain Solar to   several of my friends but also your great web site, lots of great information.
I have two family members whom I have already recommended Blue Mountains Solar to. Very nice business and workers to do business with. Exceptional customer service [SIX STARS ******]

Blue Mountains Solar offered a quality product, there was no hard pressure sales, and is a small reputable "local" company. The installation was completed promptly, and Damian was generous with his time and explanations. I'm happy to have chosen this company.

None of the three companies that were recommended suited us. Company 1 refused to install eastern-facing strings, company 2 quoted on a system that couldn't possibly fit on our roof space, and company 3 was very expensive although we liked the panels they quoted on (Sunpower). Company 3 also hassled us with repeated phone calls.I searched through other installers that were listed here and found Blue Mountains Solar. They had the Sunpower panels and SMA inverter that we wanted at 20% less than company 3's prices. They answered all my questions, were able to give a provisional quote from the initial phone conversation, and confirmed it after a site visit.They provided detailed estimates of production based on our aspect (including partial shading from a tree) and the estimates were month by month not just an annual ballpark figure. Strangely, the software used for the estimates showed that our 4.9kW of panels, split into two strings, would perform better with a 4kW inverter than with a 5kW inverter. I found it hard to believe but eventually took their advice and bought the 4kW inverter. Our system was installed a month ago and has been performing better than expected so far.The system was installed on the agreed date, and only took a few hours. Our property was left clean and tidy after the installation. Unfortunately there were a few issues with the meter installation - they have to use a contractor for this in our area. However apart from this everything went very well and we are more than happy with our system and with the service from Blue Mountains Solar.I would highly recommend Blue Mountains Solar if you are in the market for a top quality solar system.

Solar representative is very knowledgeable and provided additional information for me regarding the north or west orientation of the panels. Very satisfied with the installation. Only disappointment is the low buy back rate for power supplied to the grid (which is controlled by electricity suppliers and State Government - not the installer)

Damian and his crew provided outstanding service including fixing some problems with an existing system provided by another supplier. Despite his own problems with the recent fires in his area, he maintained contact and was 100% reliable in delivering on his commitments. It is always a pleasure to deal with friendly suppliers who are genuinely committed to customer service and are there when they promise, and at other times when you need them. As a gentleman of advanced years with decades of experience, I can confidently recommend Blue Mountains Solar as a credit to their industry.
They recommended the top quality items and explained why.

Generally very positive. This was the second installer of the 3 who quoted. Only two made contact with me so I did not pursue the first. THe second installer was a smaller company, the guy who visited installed the system. He offered a bigger and better quality system for $7000 cheaper. He was more thorough in inspecting the best installation areas. He delievered what he said and was highly efficient. Generally fairly tidy. He was in and out quickly but we did not discuss the sites of the inverters as extensively as we might have - that said it was partially my fault for not being more diligent. The first installer did follow up with me and was a bit put out that we went with the other installer.Very happy with performance so far.

Not the cheapest but very helpful. Advised us against our initial plan of a hybrid system given our usage (which we were not sure about anyway given battery technology), excellent service, no hassle to make a decision.Turned up when he said he would and installed and working same day. Other quotes, either did not turn up for an appointment arranged weeks in advance (Mark Group), were very arrogant and did not give me a written quote, or could not supply the sunpower panels we wanted.Very happy with decision and how the panels are performing so far.
These guys have good customer service. Currently awaiting installation, so hopefully all goes well.
Great guys, only a little hiccup but fixed straight away. I would recommend them.

Damian of Blue mountains solar received my business because he was punctual, supplies you with the best quality material at a competative rate, always has plenty of work which is a good sign and the clincha same day connection  to the grid. Damian does everything for you - no worries.
One of the best things was that even though I had little knowledge of solar he made it easy to understand and explained everything each step of the way.

To us, it was important to verify that the solar panels and inverter were the best quality for the price we were prepared to pay and that the company was a local one who could be trusted to be professional both in the installation and in correcting any faults that might arise in the future (ie. not a 'fly-by-nighter').

Blue Mountains Solar beat their competitors price for exactly the same components by a considerable margin.They came to install on the day we had arranged and installed quickly. The system delivers what was promised in the way of output, so we are very happy.

All went well, but they decided to install the inverter outside next to the power meters but it could have been easily installed inside the garage as I found out from some of our friends later on, Only noticed the difference when I saw the amount of sun falling on the inverter during daytime.

After careful checking with Damian and his team, we were given access to both anecdotal and well researched information to help us make a well informed decision. The integrity of  a solar provider to maintain the credibility of their own products while not bagging the quality of other solar products and after sales service was  a standout for Damian.Damian was able to clarify information about the follow-up service if the inverter  was a dud and or needed replacing. Damian could also give us a comparison of solar panels (from his own personal installations) so that we could maximise solar collections on overcoast or cloudy days.We believe we have met our aims: 1. Reducing our carbon foot print, 2. Sending excess power back to the the grid for others to use,  and  2. Hedging ourselves against higher electricity prices at this very minute and into the future.

These guys actually turned up to quote when they said they would, they did up a great presentation with the quote that covered every aspect of the system and rebates and how to get the best out of the system. They turned up when they said they would, they were quick, couteous and extremely proffessional. They left the place exactly how they found it and took all their rubbish with them. They then took a good half hour at the end to go right over the system showing me how to read the meter etc..... the last thing they did was give me a folder with all warranties and instruction manuals, tradies licence numbers etc and said dont hesitate to call if i have any questions or concerns about the system. I also recieved a 4kw inverter for a 3kw system at no extra cost so that i can put a further 4 solar panels up at a later stage for minimal cost........ these guys really hit all the right buttons from quote to supply and instalation, thanx Marc

Supplier came and gave personal quote, provided details of all options and answered all queries to the point.  Installation was professionally done, on time and on budget.  I was more than happy with the company and would definitely use them again.

The Blue Mountains Solar team provided great service from the first phone call till the installation of the system.The salesman was very informative and explained everything we needed to know about the unit and what it would provide for us.  On the day of installation the team were on time and very efficient, from our first phone call till being fully took 2 weeks.The unit is already saving us money and we couldn't be happier.

Other providers were either to cheap (too good to be true) or over expensive. The other companies wanted me to sign up with them, that put me in reverse mode and I was not interested to deal with them.One company kept ringing me every few days, whilst I was reviewing information about solar systems and forums (that was a turn off). When I informed him I was going with another company, he hung up on me. I also reviewed forums for solar systems and this company did not come up favorably. I know some these forums can be diddled by other companies to make others look bad or by some companies to make them look great.This system was not cheap, but, it was not as pricey as some providers quoted. The system came up favorably after reviewing solar information. The crew from Blue Mountains Solar provided information about my power board and meters that would require changing. The sales man was the electrician on the job and he answered all my questions.The only complaint I had was they were to supply the system on 17 December 2012 before Christmas. They said there was a problem with delivery of one of the meters (which meant I lost a days wages from work). I confirmed of the next available day and they said it would be install and working on Monday morning (07-01-2012). Work was completed before noon and we were using the power to run the air conditioner that afternoon.At present we do not have any problems, we will see after our 1/4 billing period and the change from Integral Energy (they do not provide grid buy back). We changed to AGL to buy back power, not as much as a few years ago, when the Government had a Solar Scheme for grid buy back. If we had more solar power that would reduce 'Greenhouse Gas Emissions'. The government should be providing incentives for Solar Power installation and use.

When I met Damien, he was very patient and clear with his explanations on how the solar system works and gave out good sound advice on what size panels our household would benefit us. On 14th December, 2012 Damien and his team arrived at our home The Ponds, NSW, 7.30 am on the dot and were very professional when installing the system by getting on with it and there was no dawdling around.  When they were finished Damien's team had cleared and cleaned any debris and took it with them when they left, this you wouldn't find this with other tradies.  Damien went through the process of explaining the Solar System and strongly recommended that when we receive our next electricity bill to follow this up with him to make sure everything is on track.  I would defiinitely recommend Blue Mountains Solar to anyone.

This company was efficient and professional, although their quote was the more expensive one received  they got our business because they did an onsite quote, and took the time to discuss with us how to get the best performance from our solar system even before we accepted their quote.
Quote was clear & concise.Service was great and the installation was totally painless.Very happy with the results.

Damien was very professional and made us feel comfortable about our decision. He wasn\'t the cheapest but he impressed us with his quick reply and his quote was well presented and professional . A week after agreeing to the quote our unit was fully installed without any issues. On the day of installation his team were on time and a pleasure to deal with. As for the unit itself, it\'s doing what it should be doing.\r\nWe had a quote from RK who were well presented by Gary and were also a little bit cheaper but we decided to go for our local operator. We would highly recommend Blue Mountains Solar.

From the first moment to the complete installation and even after that the information, service and professionalism displayed was first rate.Would recommend Blue Mountains Solar, they may be a bit more expensive but they are good.

These guys delivered! Great system with quality components (so you pay a bit more but you get something good), great installation, great service. Damian informed us beforehand very well about the system and listened to our wishes showing great flexibility. As an installer and former electrician himself he knows what he is talking about. No smooth talking, but real valuable information. He and his team promptly showed up when he said they would and no mucking around during installation, so halfway the afternoon we got the system on our very steep roof! Off all the companies we\'ve approached, they were the only ones who could tackle our steep roof without any problems.We chose a 4kW system and so far it is performing GREAT! We are looking on the display nearly every moment to check the performance. On full sunny days we even produce 22 to 23 kWh!!! We can recommend this company to everyone who is serious about getting a solar system, especially when it is a bit bigger. Thumbs up! Martin & Enza, NSW
Very very happy with Blue Mountains Solar, from a detailed discussion & quote to super fast installation. System is in and running, and am one very happy customer.

What ever they said HAPPENED.They turned up on time, completed the job within time they said, connected into the grid the day of installation.The installation was completed to a high workmanship level.All queries we have had have been answered immediately, professionally and in a way that is easy to understand.

After a site inspection Damien provided us with accurate, reliable information. This set them apart from other providers who weren't willing to do a site inspection.From start to finish it was a good experience.

We first met Damian of Blue Mountains Solar at his stall at the Blackheath Fair for the Rhododendron Festival. As we had been considering installing solar for some time, this was an opportunity to get some concrete information. We were impressed with his down to earth approach & knowledge so we made an appointment for him to come to our house & give us a quote. After he left I researched solar power on the net & found Finn's site which recommended getting 3 quotes which I then asked for. Of the 3 quotes, one (Nicholls Solar NSW) was unable to quote for some unknown reason, one (Mark Group Australia NSW) seemed quite expensive ($3099 for 1.48kW system Chinese panels & inverter OR $7560 1.59kW system Australian panels & German inverter) & subsequently rang us about once a week even after were said we were going with someone else. The third (Jims Solar) didn't show up for the appointed interview & only rang us half an hour after he was supposed to be here to offer a vague quote over the phone with a follow-up email which said $2,990.00 to $3240 for Chinese panels & inverter (price difference for different inverters) for 1.5kW system.We went with Blue Mountains Solar because of the quality of the cells & inverter they were offering (German designed, Chinese built panels & German inverter), reasonable price ($2488.99 for 1.6kW system including a Wattson/Holmes monitor), they are local to us (we know where they live if anything goes wrong) & because unlike the others, they are licensed electricians who can hook the system into the grid on the day they install the panels. The others said they could arrange for the system to be connected to the grid but as it was out of their hands, they couldn't say when that would happen.Damian & 2 helpers  arrived at 7:15AM on the day of the installation. The whole operation was achieved with no fuss on a 2-storey roof on a wet day (as they had all the necessary safety equipment) & it was complete with us online & pumping electricity to the grid by 10:30AM. In the process I mentioned that I had taken his advice & changed from off-peak electric hot water to on-demand gas hot water whereupon his offsider asked if I wanted the off-peak meter removed because I would still be being charged for it & they would arrange for the cancellation with the electricity company. Of course I agreed & wondered why the gas installers hadn't done this. All in all, a very helpful & efficient company.

I had a lot of trouble getting any response from the Mark Group, they looked to have a vastly superior product, but were not able to return calls, so I could not get a commitment from them. I end up with Blue Mountains Solar.
